task_title: README Agent Roles table names a nonexistent agent and omits two shipped ones
task_criteria: Proof: (1) `awk '/^### Agent Roles/{f=1} /^### File Structure/{f=0} f' README.md | grep -oE '@speclang-[a-z-]+' | tr -d '@' | sort -u | while read -r a; do test -f ".opencode/agents/$a.md" || echo "MISSING $a"; done` prints no MISSING lines; (2) `grep -ci 'speclang-test-writer' README.md` prints 0; (3) `grep -c '@speclang-simulator-verify' README.md` prints at least 1 and the Agent Roles table has a row naming @speclang-simulator; (4) the file-structure tree's "Agent definitions" line reads 6 definitions (excluding the agents README.md), matching `ls .opencode/agents/ | grep -c '\.md$'` minus the README. failure_condition: any agent named in the Agent Roles table resolves to no file under .opencode/agents/, either simulator agent is missing from the table, the nonexistent @speclang-test-writer agent is still named, or the roles count still reads 5.
